md244.page_text:
Title: Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025 on the Implementation of the Electronic Invoicing System

URL Source: https://mof.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Ministerial-Decision-No.-244-of-2025-on-the-Implementation-of-the-Electronic-Invoicing-System.pdf

Markdown Content:
Article 3 - Pilot Programme

4. The Pilot Programme shall commence on 1 July 2026.

Article 5 - Mandatory Implementation

1. The Electronic Invoicing System shall be implemented in the following phases:
(a) A Person subject to the Electronic Invoicing System and whose Revenue is equal to or exceeds
AED 50,000,000 shall appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 31 July 2026 and shall implement
the Electronic Invoicing System by 1 January 2027.
(b) A Person subject to the Electronic Invoicing System and whose Revenue is less than AED
50,000,000 shall appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 31 March 2027 and shall implement
the Electronic Invoicing System by 1 July 2027.
(c) A Government Entity shall appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 31 March 2027 and shall
implement the Electronic Invoicing System by 1 October 2027.

md66.page_text:
Title: Ministerial Decision No. (66) of 2026

Markdown Content:
Article One

Paragraph (a) of Clause (1) of Article (5) of Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025 referred to above, shall
be replaced by the following:

(a) A Person subject to the Electronic Invoicing System and whose Revenue is equal to or exceeds
AED 50,000,000 shall appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 30 October 2026 and shall
implement the Electronic Invoicing System by 1 January 2027.

mof_news.page_text:
Title: Ministry of Finance announces targeted amendments to eInvoicing system decisions

Published Time: 2026-05-10T09:00:00+04:00

Markdown Content:
The Ministry of Finance announced targeted amendments to the eInvoicing system decisions. The amendments extend the deadline for entities whose annual revenues exceed AED 50 million to appoint an accredited service provider from 31 July 2026 to 30 October 2026. Mandatory implementation remains due no later than 1 January 2027.

sa_secondary_a.page_text:
Title: Saudi Arabia: e-invoicing integration wave announced

Markdown Content:
Taxpayers in the next integration wave whose revenue exceeds SAR 750,000 must integrate their e-invoicing solutions with the FATOORA platform by 31 March 2027, according to the authority's notice.
